data.name: Dhilan
data.gender_notes: Dhilan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhilan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'dhila' meaning 'protection' or 'grace'. This name is believed to be bestowed upon a child by the gods, signifying divine protection and blessings. The name is often used in Hindu mythology to refer to deities or divine beings. The name Dhilan carries the meaning “God's grace, divine protection” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhilan usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, divine protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dhilan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace, divine protection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhilan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
